explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/808: the conjecture that for c, ε > 0 and large n, any n-set A ⊂ ℕ with a graph G of ≥ n^{1+c} edges has max(|A +_G A|, |A ·_G A|) ≥ n^{1+c−ε} was disproved by Alon, Ruzsa and Solymosi (graphs with ≫ n^{5/3−o(1)} edges and both sets ≪ n^{4/3+o(1)}). The Lean statement negates ∀ c > 0, ∀ ε > 0, ∃ n₀, ∀ V finite, injective labelling a : V ↪ ℕ, graph G with |V| ≥ n₀ and |E| ≥ |V|^{1+c}: |V|^{1+c−ε} ≤ max(#edgeSums, #edgeProducts). Encoding A as an injective image of V is equivalent to A ⊂ ℕ with |A| = n and G a graph on A; the ARS construction (with c slightly below 2/3 and small ε) witnesses the negation. Allowing 0 ∈ A only makes the universal statement stronger, so the negation is unaffected (the positive-integer version is a separate variant). Faithful.
